name: The Gold Bond Group Ltd.
summary: Gold Bond Group Ltd. is an Israeli logistics and terminal operator specializing in comprehensive warehousing, transportation, and supply chain solutions for diverse goods and shipping containers. Its extensive services encompass a variety of terminal operations, including customs supervision for both container and general cargo terminals, efficient container handling (storage and unloading), rail transport options, and the secure storage and movement of hazardous materials. Moreover, Gold Bond offers advanced logistical support such as temperature and climate-controlled storage facilities, cleaning services for TK and tanker units, storage for refrigerated (RF) containers, and e-commerce fulfillment centers. The company also provides heavy-duty forklift rentals. The group actively manages and operates significant terminals located in Ashdod, Haifa, and by the Jordan River. It caters to a broad clientele, including importers, exporters, shipping and delivery firms, customs brokerage agencies, and maritime enterprises. Founded in 1963, the company was initially known as H.M.N Paper Products Factory Ltd. before officially changing its name to The Gold Bond Group Ltd. in February 1994, and its main office is situated in Ashdod, Israel.
